description: Sign a message as the smart account (ERC-1271) with a local EOA saved by `splits auth create-key` or `splits auth import-key`. This can authorize compatible x402 or MPP payments as well as WalletConnect and Splits Connect requests; the payment method must accept ERC-1271 and package the signature. Pass exactly one of --message (plain text, personal_sign), --hex (raw bytes, personal_sign) or --typed-data (EIP-712 JSON), plus --chain-id. Creates the message, signs its signingHash, and returns the smart account signature once signatureCount reaches threshold. On a multisig the result has signature null; other signers add theirs with --id.

address.description: Account address (0x...) that signs the message

chainId.description: Chain id the signature is valid on. Required unless --id is set.

id.description: Sign an existing message instead of creating one

key.description: Address of the local key to sign with. Required when several local keys are saved.

message.description: Plain text to sign with personal_sign

name.description: Label shown in the web app

typedData.description: EIP-712 typed data as JSON (domain, types, primaryType, message)

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounts_sign-message
